title: RiDEx: Reward-Informed Directional Exploration for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22052v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reward-based diffusion post-training updates model parameters from task rewards. While existing approaches improve sampling and policy optimization, they still rely largely on isotropic random perturbations in a high-dimensional latent space for exploration. Such variation often spends the perturbation budget on changes with little influence on the target reward, making exploration inefficient. We study where diffusion models should explore and how to learn from that exploration. We introduce Reward-Informed Directional Exploration (RiDEx), which concentrates local exploration in reward-relevant subspaces of the denoising velocity field. Conditional residuals or differentiable reward gradients propose the subspace, and equal-and-opposite perturbations at the same generation state measure its terminal reward response. The reward difference supplies signed local supervision in the explored coordinates, while all generated images contribute

translated_title: RiDEx：面向扩散强化学习的奖励感知定向探索
translated_abstract: 基于奖励的扩散模型后训练通过任务奖励来更新模型参数。尽管现有方法改进了采样和策略优化，但它们在很大程度上仍依赖于高维潜空间中的各向同性随机扰动进行探索。这种变化往往会把扰动预算花费在对目标奖励影响甚微的改变上，导致探索效率低下。我们研究扩散模型应当在哪里探索以及如何从探索中学习。我们提出了奖励感知定向探索（RiDEx），它将局部探索集中在去噪速度场中与奖励相关的子空间内。该子空间由条件残差或可微奖励梯度提出，并通过在同一生成状态下施加等大反向的扰动来测量其对最终奖励的响应。奖励差异在被探索的坐标上提供带符号的局部监督信号，同时所有生成的图像均有所贡献。
tldr: RiDEx通过将局部探索集中在去噪速度场中与奖励相关的子空间，并利用等大反向扰动的奖励差异提供带符号的局部监督，从而替代低效的各向同性随机扰动，显著提升了基于奖励的扩散模型后训练的探索效率。
en_tdlr: RiDEx improves reward-based diffusion post-training by concentrating local exploration in reward-relevant subspaces of the denoising velocity field and using equal-and-opposite perturbations to derive signed local supervision from reward differences, replacing inefficient isotropic random perturbations.
